description: Agent Bookkeeping: submit a chart of accounts: the chart with its reference, the business it belongs to, the day it is read on, and each account with its id, account number, name, type (asset, liability, equity, income or expense), the statement section it maps to, whether it is active, its balance and its last posting day. The signed report gives the chart, the accounts that repeat by number or by name once filler words such as expense and account are set aside, the dormant accounts that still carry a balance, the accounts whose names read as personal spending, and the accounts with no type or section, and counts them, and names a divergent chart: a duplicate or near-duplicate account, a dormant account still carrying a balance, a personal-sounding account inside the business’s books, and an account missing a type or section mapping; then an account in a section of another type and an unnumbered account in a numbered chart, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No accounts, no balances, or no active flags or last posting days with a chart date leaves those points unverified. Names read with plurals folded, an account is dormant when marked inactive or with no posting for 365 days before the chart date, and personal names read from a closed word list such as personal, family, vacation and groceries. This reads the chart of accounts as supplied, the list of accounts the books post to. Verdict bookkeeping_chart_divergent, bookkeeping_chart_partial, bookkeeping_chart_unverified or bookkeeping_chart_consistent. POST /api/bookkeeping-chart-check. Reads the bookkeeping records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the books as supplied only: it never posts or edits an entry, never moves money or pays a bill, never files anything with any authority and gives no tax advice, which stay with the business, its bookkeeper and its advisers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Bookkeeping reads a business’s own books for internal consistency and against the records they should agree with: a general-ledger extract, a bank reconciliation, journal entries, a chart of accounts, a period close, the accounts payable ledger, a payroll register and the accounts receivable ledger, each against its own debits and credits, the source totals supplied, the bank statement and the ledger balance, the open period, the posting queue and recurring entries, or the ledger postings and pay schedule it should agree with. The family reads bookkeeping, the record a business keeps of its own transactions in its ledger and journals, and reads the records against each other. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-bookkeeping-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-bookkeeping/.
